tutor:explain price elasticity of demand:
Price elasticity of demand = % change in quantity demanded / % change in price.

It measures how sensitive buyers are to price:

* Elastic (>1): quantity changes a lot — e.g. luxuries, substitutes available.
* Inelastic (<1): quantity changes little — e.g. necessities, no substitutes.
